definitions.explanation: A clot of blood that forms inside a blood vessel and can block it, causing a stroke or heart attack. A medical word also common in health news.

examples.japanese: {血栓|けっせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{血栓|けっせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{血管|けっかん}→血管：02742_kekkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}まった→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧。
examples.english: A blood clot blocked a blood vessel in the brain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧ままで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{血栓|けっせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Sitting for hours on a plane makes blood clots in the legs more likely.

notes:
{血|けつ} (blood) + ⟦{栓|せん}→栓：19366_sen⟧ (plug, stopper).

- {血栓|けっせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: a clot forms
- {血栓|けっせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: a clot blocks a vessel
